question: Which acts of reviling Shiva or the Kula Bhairava prohibit transmission of the teaching?
premises: Reviling Shiva is explicitly forbidden as a recipient trait.
Slandering the Kula Bhairava is also forbidden.
The prohibition is addressed to the Goddess.
inference: The teaching must not be given to anyone who reviles Shiva or slanders the Kula Bhairava.
plain_english: O Goddess, not to one who reviles Shiva, nor to one who slanders the Kula Bhairava.
